patch_description: Replace the uniform pick of 1-3 bottleneck points with membership-count-weighted selection, and add a correlated move of the top-2 bottleneck points along the same random direction (a "shear/rigid" micro-move). Coordinated moves can escape single-point traps where any individual move worsens the min area but a joint displacement improves it. Also add a cheap local polish pass after annealing (axis-aligned micro-moves on the highest-membership bottleneck point), which the earlier top program showed to be effective. Vectorized `_project` and areas are kept unchanged.
